geometry.note: This is the surface building footprint, not a survey of the underground collision point. The Tevatron ring (geometry:fermilab-tevatron-ring) is placed independently of this footprint; the building lies just outside the ring, as a surface building beside an underground collision hall should. The atlas site record site:fermilab-d0-collision-hall now carries this footprint's centroid as its point (accuracy 40 m). As of 2026-09-18 this was the first sourced coordinate found for the D0 hall: an earlier OpenStreetMap query of the campus buildings returned only the CDF Hall, and this building was found by a name search for 'D0' within the campus bounding box.

method: OpenStreetMap way 51755107 'D0 Assembly building' footprint, traced verbatim (way 51755108 'D0 Outback', a small adjacent structure, was also fetched but not included in this footprint).
name: D0 Assembly Building (Tevatron D0)
